title: Implement the optional application packet flush cadence axis
summary: Implement REQ-QUIC-CRT-0192 as a closed legacy_current and prompt seam at the existing optional small-write delay with forcing, observe-only, shadow, safety fallback, unified evidence, exact raw joins, and force-legacy rollback while measurement and active behavior remain frozen.

verification_plan: Build the affected runtime, test project, and raw host in Release. Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0192 and unified REQ-QUIC-CRT-0183. Verify every value and mode, force-legacy rollback, prompt versus retained delay, decision and latch boundaries, retransmission, validation, lifecycle and invalid-input fallback, adjacent-axis rejection, configured empty epochs, schemas, exact sample-to-epoch joins, aggregate recomputation, packaging, FIN, cancellation, and existing application-send delay behavior. Do not run performance, campaigns, transforms, ML, CI, or active behavior.

Changing congestion, pacing, flow-control, packet-protection, recovery, ownership, or terminal authority
